blocks.x: Engineering standards & stack

items: hash-linked anchoring
Records anchored by hash so tampering is detectable — trust with a checksum.
permissioned DLT
Shared ledgers with known counterparties and governed writes — DLT where it earns its keep.
HSM key ceremonies
Key generation and rotation performed under ceremony, with the evidence auditors require.
on-chain/off-chain split
What must be tamper-evident goes on ledger; the bulk stays off it, linked and provable.

blocks.x: Integration surface

items: meter data platforms

market & settlement systems
Market data and settlement joined, so every position reconciles to a known price.
work & asset management
Work orders and asset history in one loop — maintenance planned from evidence.
SCADA / EMS cores
Grid operations integrated read-only — control stays deterministic, decisions get smarter.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
